test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 23 Aug 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: Four friends W, X, Y and Z are sitting at the corners of a square table facing towards the centre. W and Z are not at the opposite corners, but W is to the immediate right of Y. Who among the following is sitting opposite to X?
solution:
According to the given information,

1) W is to the immediate right of Y. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4cb01f11c94d4937c1827489f6827ea19f2e54a9703c48f168ffd1aefda3b9d5.png] 

2) W and Z are not at the opposite corners

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/b88800de146048147139452e937ca09f0a32b6c2b152394d129ee9060aab8172.png] 

Here, we can see that W sits opposite to X.

Hence, the correct answer is **"W"**.
